The OSS-Fuzz issue 42539076 for freetype2 - let me search for what the fix was. This issue was found around 2022. Let me look at the freetype2 git history for fixes related to heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 4 around that time. The issue number 42539076 corresponds to a specific bug. Let me check the known freetype2 CVEs/fixes around that time.

Let me look at the `ttgxvar.c` file since it deals with glyph variations and is a common source of heap-buffer-overflow issues. Let me also check what version this is and look for known bugs.
